data.name: Dead Star Prison
data.detailed_description:
Dead Star Prison:

The darkest corners of space carry no sound, but inside Dead Star Prison, the screams are deafening.

Carved into the cold, pale husk of a long since destroyed white dwarf, this fortified hell is a ghost hidden amongst the stars—a tomb for the galaxy's most dangerous mistakes. Here, the gravity is heavy enough to crush the spirit of even the strongest of wills, thick shadows hidden with things that haven't seen a sun in centuries.

The Inmates:

A rogue collection of the galaxies most damned and dangerous and in some cases, the innocent. Creatures, monsters, conmen and brutal warlords alike, each carrying horror strewn histories and teeming full of unknown powers.

*Innocents buried here by to ensure they stay silent.

The Way Out:

At the heart of the prison lies The Crucible, a blood-stained arena where the laws of the galaxy are replaced by a single rule: Survive

The Warden offers a simple deal—The Freedom Clause. You fight. You probably die - but, if you survive and win, you are granted your freedom. But in a "Winner Takes All" , the "All" usually ends up in a shallow grave in the star's metallic crust.

Welcome to Dead Star Prison. Think you've got what it takes to get out? Pick your weapon. Say your prayers. Let the show begin.

"In dead star prison, there's only way out - and its carved from the ribcage of your enemy."

Gameplay:

Dead Star Prison is a unique combination of Deck Building and strategy based Auto-Battling.

Build you deck of prisoners and be sure to place them in the most strategic position on the battleground to conquer your enemies in either PVP mode or the single player story mode.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th generation or newer) / AMD equivalent (Dual-core with 4 threads)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD/UHD graphics (e.g., HD 620) or an entry-level dedicated card like the NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes: The goal of the game is to create an army that will fight your opponents army. There is no gore or blood in the battle, but the characters do visually strike the opponents and have a dissolve/fade away death.
